name: lying leg raise v. 2
description: Raising your legs while lying on your back. It works the lower abs and the hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches.
Keep your legs as straight as you comfortably can.
